title: Effects of a School-based Intervention to Increase the Water Consumption in Elementary School Children
brief_summary: The purpose of this controlled intervention study is to evaluate the effectiveness of a school-based intervention aiming at increasing the water consumption in elementary school children. The intervention schools received refillable water bottles and drying racks for all school children as well as educational material. The focus of the intervention is the promotion of drinking tap water.
raw_criteria:
For the intervention schools:

Inclusion criteria:

* elementary school in Niederösterreich (Upper Austria, a province of Austria)
* no juice provided with the school milk programme

For the school children taking part in the survey:

Inclusion criteria:

* school children in third class of elementary school (at baseline)
* written declaration of consent by a parent/guardian
